# Tinkercast

> > Award-winning STEAM podcasts and project-based learning platform for kids, classrooms, and families.

Tinkercast is a premier educational media company offering science and storytelling podcasts like Wow in the World and TinkerClass, alongside curriculum resources designed for K-5 classrooms and homeschoolers. The platform combines audio content with hands-on learning activities to engage children in STEAM education.

## Key Topics

- Wow in the World
- TinkerClass
- STEAM education
- Project-based learning
- Science podcasts
- K-5 curriculum
- Classroom integration
- Podjects
- Guy Raz
- Audio storytelling
- Educational activities
- Homeschool resources
- Design thinking
- Family-friendly content
- Wondery

## Featured Podcasts

- [Wow in the World](https://tinkercast.com/shows/wow-in-the-world): Award-winning science podcast hosted by Guy Raz and Mindy Thomas exploring fascinating discoveries and phenomena
- [Who, When, Wow!](https://tinkercast.com/shows/who-when-wow): History podcast with Carly Q exploring ancient mysteries and time travel adventures
- [Flip and Mozi](https://tinkercast.com/shows/earthling): Intergalactic musical podcast celebrating animals and Earth science
- [Once Upon a Beat](https://tinkercast.com/all-podcasts/once-upon-a-beat): Hip-hop podcast remixing classic stories with DJ Fyütch and Baby Scratch
- [Two Whats?! And A Wow!](https://tinkercast.com/shows/two-whats-and-a-wow): Science-based game show podcast for kids featuring fact vs. fiction challenges
- [WeWow](https://tinkercast.com/shows/wewow): Variety science show encouraging kids to engage with WOW in the universe
- [All Podcasts Directory](https://tinkercast.com/all-podcasts): Complete directory of Tinkercast podcasts for kids and families

## Learning Platforms & Curriculum

- [TinkerClass](https://tinkercast.com/tinkerclass): Free podcast and project-based learning platform with design thinking framework for K-5 students
- [TinkerClass @ Home Subscription](https://tinkercast.com/membership/tinkerclass-homeschool): Homeschool subscription with standards-aligned podcasts and hands-on projects
- [TinkerClass Resources](https://tinkercast.com/teachers/tinkerclass/resources): Teacher resources including lesson guides and podject framework documentation
- [Podcasts in the Classroom](https://tinkercast.com/teachers): STEAM podcasts and TinkerClass curriculum for K-5 classroom integration

## Teacher & Classroom Resources

- [Teacher Resources Blog](https://tinkercast.com/blog/teacher-resources): Blog focused on STEAM classroom engagement and student listening strategies
- [Share Podjects](https://tinkercast.com/share-podjects): Gallery for teachers to share student work and classroom projects
- [Teacher Contact & Support](https://tinkercast.com/teacher-contact): Teacher contact form for support, FAQs, and troubleshooting assistance

## Memberships & Subscriptions

- [WOW Subscription Membership](https://tinkercast.com/membership/paid-wow-membership): World Organization of Wowzers subscription with exclusive content and benefits
- [TinkerClass @ Home Subscription](https://tinkercast.com/membership/tinkerclass-homeschool): Homeschool subscription with standards-aligned podcasts and projects
